## Ruling input — the maintainer's stated business requirement, and the measurement that prices it

`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`. ⛔ **Not a ruling** — this card awaits one, and this seat does not produce it. This is the input, with the measurement that makes it cheap.

**The maintainer's steer, verbatim:** 「从我们的业务需求角度，我应该只需要 `object-kanban`」 — *from our business-requirements point of view, we should only need `object-kanban`.*

That does not select one of this card's four options. It proposes a **fifth**: retire the bare `kanban` node key, which **dissolves this card's divergence instead of patching it** — there is no arm left to disagree with the registry `inputs`.

I measured what that would cost. It is far less than I first believed, and the reason is the interesting part.

## ⭐ The finding that changes the price: the console path never produces the bare key

`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` is the adapter that turns a **stored `NamedListView`** into a rendered node. Its `switch (viewType)` (`:1311`) maps every stored view type to a node type, and **it already emits `object-kanban`**:

```
packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx
  :1384   type: 'object-kanban',     ← the `case 'kanban':` branch
  :1404   type: 'object-calendar',
  :1419   type: 'object-gallery',
  :1449   type: 'object-timeline',
  :1472   type: 'object-gantt',
  :1490   type: 'object-map',
  :1505   type: 'object-tree',
  :1625   type: 'object-grid',
  :1668   type: 'object-form',
```

**Firing control:** twelve emitted node types on the same instrument, an unbroken `object-*` family — so `object-kanban` at `:1384` is a reading, not a lone match from a matcher that finds one thing.

The only `type: 'kanban'` anywhere in that file is at **`:613`, inside a JSDoc comment**, and it documents the **stored** `NamedListView.type` (`board: { label: 'By Status', type: 'kanban', options: { kanban: { … } } }`) — not an emitted node.

⇒ **Two different things at two different layers, and this card has been reading them as one:**

| layer | value | who writes it | affected by retiring the node key? |
|---|---|---|---|
| stored `NamedListView.type` | `"kanban"` | `CreateViewDialog`, persisted per tenant | ⛔ **NO** |
| node type key | `kanban` \| `object-kanban` | hand-authored JSON; `ObjectView` emits only `object-kanban` | ✅ yes |

⇒ **Every kanban view any user ever created through the console already renders through `object-kanban`.** The maintainer's business requirement is, on the product surface, **already met**. ⛔ Retiring the bare node key touches **zero stored documents** — the data-migration objection that would normally sink a change like this does not arise.

## What the bare `kanban` node key actually is, then

A **hand-authoring alias**. Both keys dispatch to the same renderer — `packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx:579` (`object-kanban`) and `:589` (`kanban`), both `ObjectKanbanRenderer`. Re-measured on `origin/main` `dcbf0b2bc`, exact node-type spellings, whole repo:

| spelling | JSON documents | TS/TSX files |
|---|---|---|
| `kanban` | **3** | 38 |
| `object-kanban` | **0** | — |
| `kanban-ui` | **0** | **0** |
| `kanban-enhanced` | **0** | **0** |
| control `object-grid` | 2 | 128 |
| control `zzz-not-a-type` | 0 | — |

Two controls, both behaving: a real sibling fires, an absent name is silent.

⭐ Note `kanban-ui` and `kanban-enhanced`: **registered type keys that no document in the repository authors, in either language.** Not this card's business, but they belong in whatever ruling reaches this family — and objectui#8818, filed today, turns on `kanban-ui` being reachable.

### The full migration surface, enumerated

**3 JSON documents**, all fixtures:
- `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/plugin-kanban/basic-kanban-board.json`
- `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/plugin-kanban/advanced-kanban-with-badges-and-limits.json`
- `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/components-complex-view-switcher/view-switcher.json`

**38 TS/TSX files** — of which **29 are tests** and **9 are non-test**, and three of those nine *are the retirement itself* rather than consumers of it:

| file | role |
|---|---|
| `packages/types/src/complex.ts` | the arm declaration — **is** the change |
| `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` | the mirror — **is** the change |
| `packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx` | the `:589` registration — **is** the change |
| `packages/types/src/registry.ts` | `'kanban': KanbanSchema` at `:201` |
| `packages/plugin-kanban/src/types.ts` | |
| `packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx` | |
| `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` | the `case 'kanban':` **stored**-type label — ⚠️ must NOT change |
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/CreateViewDialog.tsx` | writes the **stored** type — ⚠️ must NOT change |
| `packages/types/examples/zod-validation-example.ts` | |

**2 docs pages teach the bare spelling** and are the real user-facing cost: `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` (7 occurrences) and `content/docs/utilities/runner.mdx`.

⚠️ **The two files marked "must NOT change" are the trap in this route.** Both mention `kanban` as the **stored view type**, and a migration that pattern-matched the spelling would rewrite them and break every stored view — converting a zero-data-migration change into the worst kind. Any dispatch on this route has to name that distinction up front.

## ⚠️ Corrections to my own earlier figures

I earlier put this migration at **~79 sites** (`content/docs` JSON 6 + TS 9, `examples` JSON 3 + TS 1, `packages` JSON 5 + TS 55). That instrument counted the **identifier anywhere** — prose, imports, `object-kanban` and `kanban-ui` substrings included — not authored node-type spellings. The table above is the tighter instrument with controls, and it supersedes those numbers in both directions. I also earlier reported `object-kanban` as `1 JSON + 1 TS`; on this instrument it is **0 JSON**, and the reason is the whole finding above — nobody hand-authors it because the adapter emits it.

## ⛔ What this input does not decide

- ⛔ **Not claimed the bare key should be retired.** That is this card's ruling to make, and a retirement of a published node key is a narrowing of the accept set ⇒ Clause ② with `needs:contract-review` on card and PR.
- ⛔ **Not claimed the four options are dead.** If the ruling is that the alias stays, this card's original divergence stands and needs option A, B, C or D on its own merits.
- ⛔ **Not claimed the docs cost is small.** `schema-reference.md` is what teaches authors the spelling; changing it changes what every future hand-authored document says.
- ⛔ No label, priority or `domain:*` touched, and ⛔ no assignee written.

Refs: objectui#7742 / PR #8799 (which filed this card) · objectui#8801 · objectui#8818 · objectui#8652 · ADR-0049.

## Ruling recorded — **retire the bare `kanban` node key** (maintainer, 2026-09-09)

`domain:spec` @ objectui PM seat, session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`. Asked directly with the measurement in the question; the maintainer chose the **fifth option** this seat recorded at `5601352531`, not one of this card's original four.

⇒ **This card's divergence is dissolved rather than patched.** With no `kanban` arm, there is no arm left to disagree with the registry `inputs` about `titleField` — options A, B, C and D all become moot.

## Why the fifth option was available at all — the finding that made it cheap

⭐ The decisive measurement, re-verified for this ruling: `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`'s `switch (viewType)` — the adapter that turns a **stored `NamedListView`** into a node — **already emits `object-kanban`** (`:1384`), as it does for the whole family:

```
:1384 object-kanban   :1404 object-calendar  :1419 object-gallery  :1449 object-timeline
:1472 object-gantt    :1490 object-map       :1505 object-tree     :1625 object-grid
```

Twelve emitted node types, an unbroken `object-*` family — that is the firing control that makes `:1384` a reading rather than a lone match.

⇒ **Two layers, not two spellings of one thing:**

| layer | value | who writes it | affected by this retirement? |
|---|---|---|---|
| stored `NamedListView.type` | `"kanban"` | `CreateViewDialog`, persisted per tenant | ⛔ **NO** |
| node type key | `kanban` / `object-kanban` | hand-authored JSON only | ✅ yes |

⇒ **Every kanban view any user ever created through the console already renders through `object-kanban`.** Retiring the bare node key touches **zero stored documents** — the data-migration objection that normally sinks a change like this does not arise.

## The migration surface, measured

| spelling | JSON | TS/TSX files |
|---|---|---|
| bare `kanban` | **3** (all `examples/schema-catalog` fixtures) | 38 — of which **29 tests** and **9 non-test** |
| `object-kanban` | 0 | — |
| control `object-grid` | 2 | 128 |
| control `zzz-not-a-type` | 0 | — |

Three of the nine non-test files **are the retirement itself** (`complex.ts`, `zod/complex.zod.ts`, `plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx`). Real user-facing cost: **2 docs pages** — `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` (7 occurrences) and `content/docs/utilities/runner.mdx`.

## ⛔ The trap the implementing seat must not fall into

⚠️ **`ObjectView.tsx`'s `case 'kanban':` and `CreateViewDialog.tsx` both mention `kanban` as the STORED view type. They must NOT change.** A migration that pattern-matched the string would rewrite them and break every stored kanban view — converting a zero-data-migration change into the worst kind. **The ruling covers the node type key only.**

⚠️ And the mechanism rule: `BaseSchema` is `.passthrough()`, so a **dropped** key is *kept*, not refused. A retirement needs a **named refusal** (`retirementTombstone` on the zod face, `?: never` on the TS face) plus compile-time pins — the objectui#7664 failure, and the pattern PR #8799 executed correctly on this very arm.

## Sibling rulings in the same batch — read them together

| card | ruling | measured |
|---|---|---|
| **objectui#8257** | retire **`kanban-enhanced`** and **`kanban-ui`** | both authored **0** times, JSON and TS |
| **objectui#8008** | retire the bare **`gantt`** registration | authored **0** times |

⚠️ **objectui#8818 interacts with the `kanban-ui` half** and must be read before that one is implemented: an authored `objectFields` still reaches the predicate layer through `SchemaRenderer`'s generic prop spread on the `kanban-ui` entry. Retiring that registration closes that hole as a side effect — which is good, but it means #8818's own disposition changes and should not be ruled independently afterwards.

⇒ **These are one family being converged deliberately**, not four independent retirements. Whoever implements any of them should sequence with the others rather than racing them into the same files.

⛔ **Nothing here is re-opened.** The maintainer ruled the direction; the dev implements it. If a measurement falsifies a premise, **STOP and report** — ⛔ do not pick a different route.
